description: This file contains unit tests for the NoteController class, testing CRUD operations like create, list, update, and delete notes within the web layer of the application.

classes.name: NoteControllerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing NoteController endpoints using MockMvc and Mockito.

methods.name: create_shouldReturn201
methods.description: Tests creating a note with valid data responds with HTTP 201 and returns the created note data.

methods.name: create_shouldValidate_andReturn400
methods.description: Tests validation logic during note creation, expecting a HTTP 400 bad request for invalid input.

methods.name: list_shouldReturnPage
methods.description: Tests listing notes returns a paginated response containing note data.

methods.name: update_shouldReturn200
methods.description: Tests updating an existing note responds with HTTP 200 and updated note data.

methods.name: delete_shouldReturn204
methods.description: Tests deleting a note responds with HTTP 204 No Content.
